turns.content: Yaar meri shaadi mein six weeks bache hain. Rohan ko haldi mein hona hai, toast bhi dena hai — first year college se mera bhai hai. Par jab bhi Bangalore se travel ki baat karta hoon, bas "dekhte hain yaar, pakka try karunga." Main khud hi uski flight book kar doon kya, khatam jhanjhat?

Bhai, seedha bol — Rohan ko pakad ke rakhna padega warna woh "dekhte hain" karke nikal jayega. 

Flight book kar de, lekin ek baar clearly bol de ki "main book kar raha hoon, bata flight kaunsi theek rahegi." Agar woh phir bhi vague kare toh khud hi book kar dena. Shaadi mein important role hai uska, baad mein regret nahi hona chahiye. 

Tu tension mat le, bas ek baar final kar le usse.

Maine check kiya, nau hazaar ki return flight hai, koi bada amount nahi. Usne do mahine pehle job switch kiya, koi startup hai. Aur aajkal uske replies bhi two-word aate hain, pehle voice notes bhejta tha. Bol raha hoon khud ko ki busy hoga, par hafton se yahi chal raha hai.

Bhai, yeh do-word replies aur pehle wale voice notes ka farak clearly dikhta hai. Startup job switch ke baad log aksar aise hi ho jaate hain — overwhelmed, thoda disconnected. Tu khud ko yeh bol raha hai ki "busy hoga", lekin dil mein pata hai ki woh pehle jaisa nahi lag raha.

9k badi baat nahi hai, lekin agar tu book kar bhi dega aur woh phir bhi confirm nahi karega toh aur bura lagega. Ek baar call kar ke seedha pooch le — "Bhai shaadi mein aa raha hai na? Main flight dekh raha hoon." Agar uska response phir bhi vague ho toh samajh ja ki priority mein tu ab pehle number pe nahi hai.

Tu decide kar — kitna force karna chahta hai is dosti ko ab.

Sach bolun toh ab bura lagne laga hai. Agar sach mein care karta toh pehle din haan bol deta na? Soch raha hoon aaj raat call karke seedha puchh loon — "bhai aa raha hai ya nahi, haan ya na." Kam se kam pata toh chalega main kahan khada hoon.

Bilkul, ab itna lamba wait karne ka koi fayda nahi. Call kar aur seedha pooch le — "Bhai, sach bata, aa raha hai ya nahi? Mujhe final karna hai." 

Agar woh phir bhi vague karega ya "dekhte hain" bolega, toh samajh ja ki ab priority mein tu pehle wala dost nahi raha. Thoda bura lagega, par kam se kam clarity toh milegi. 

Tu call kar le aaj, aur jo bhi reply aaye, bata dena. Main yahin hoon.

Meri fiancée bol rahi hai main overthink kar raha hoon, woh bas busy hoga. Par yeh wahi banda hai jo 2019 mein meri behen ki shaadi ke liye overnight bus se aaya tha. Kuch toh badla hai aur samajh nahi aa raha kya, aur haldi se do hafte pehle main usse naraaz baitha hoon, yeh feeling hi ganda hai.

Bhai, woh 2019 wala scene yaad aana natural hai — us time pe usne itni mehnat ki thi tere liye. Ab yeh vague replies dekh ke lagta hai kuch badla hai, aur yeh feeling ganda hi lagta hai, koi overthinking nahi. Fiancée shayad busy hone ki baat kar rahi hai, lekin dosti mein priority badalna bhi hota hai kabhi-kabhi.

Call kar le aaj, seedha aur calm tareeke se pooch. Jo bhi jawab aaye, woh tere liye clarity dega. Baad mein bata dena kya hua, main sun raha hoon.
